summary: Iter32 tested FrasbergAI OpenAI-compatible provider gateway + Docs page + tip leaderboard + gallery marquee thumbnails. Backend: 15/15 pytest passed in 8.3s (see /app/backend/tests/test_iter32_gateway.py). Verified: GET /api/v1/models returns OpenAI list with all 7 luchii ids (luchii-6-plus/mini/embed, luchii-70b/7b/1b/200m) owned_by=frasbergai; GET /api/v1/provider returns registry.id=frasbergai auth=bearer sse=true, manifest.openai_compatible=true, providers list contains 'frasbergai' (strings, not dicts), verified=true; all 3 backend /api/.well-known/* docs return 200 (frasbergai-provider.json, provider-manifest.json, openapi.yaml); frontend static /.well-known/frasbergai-provider.json and /provider-manifest.json 200. Minted luchii-sk key via /api/keys (name TEST_iter32_gateway) and executed chat.completions non-stream (returns object='chat.completion' + choices[0].message.content + usage), multi-turn (system+user+assistant+user, 200 OK), streaming (SSE chat.completion.chunk frames, finish_reason=stop, terminated by 'data: [DONE]'). Invalid model name → 404. No-auth chat → 401. Embeddings: 2 vectors of exactly 384 dims each with usage; no-auth 401. Usage metering: after all calls, GET /api/keys shows request_count>0 on the used key. Tip leaderboard GET /api/rooms/room-linq-001/tips/leaderboard → 200 with {roomId, leaderboard:[]}. Regression native POST /api/v1/chat with Bearer key still streams data. Test key cleaned up. FRONTEND: /docs public page (no login) fully renders [data-testid=docs-page]; language tabs docs-lang-{curl,python,javascript} switch snippets; docs-models-table and docs-discovery both present; copy buttons and 'Get API Key' link present; Navbar Explore dropdown → [data-testid=nav-explore-api-docs] navigates to /docs (must click nav-explore-btn to open menu — not hover). Homepage gallery marquee shows [data-testid=marquee-row-1] and marquee-row-2 each with 14 elements sourced from /gallery-thumbs/*.jpg. /linq LinqLive tab shows '💸 Top tippers' section (empty state). /linq History tab now correctly renders 8 cashapp billing rows (iter31 bug FIXED). /linq Plans tab clicks OK. Console shows a few /api/keys 401s on public homepage — expected (guest mode).
